info.title: Sketch2Life FE API
info.description:
Implemented FE APIs aligned to SRS v2.2: organization, class, profile, consent, and Teacher lesson preparation.

Bearer authentication and role/resource access are checked per operation.

Not available yet: Parent profile/story/activity; Teacher occurrence, Sketch Deck, sample video; job/playback; quota/payment; notifications.

SRS §9.6 lists proposed routes. This page documents current backend paths only.
